issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation adds 'Có lẽ' (Perhaps/Maybe), which is not present in the Greek text. The Greek 'μηποτε' functions as a negative particle ('not at all' or 'not even') modifying the verb 'εγνωσαν' (knew), rather than expressing uncertainty.
Because of the addition of 'Có lẽ', the negation 'μηποτε' (not at all) is lost. The Greek says they did NOT know at all; the Vietnamese implies they might have known.
